ocr.notes: Image reads 'Monday, June the 28th', not 25th; 'stockholder' printed for stakeholder in the first paragraph; '$1,500' and '$3,000'.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch printed George Rooke's reply to Tom Allen's retirement card, saying their June 17 match fell through over the choice of stakeholder, and challenging Allen to fight him without stakes.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Dispatch', Tuesday Evening, June 22, 1875; named per rubric rule for pre-1878 Dispatch.

facts.fact: Allen published a card announcing his retirement from the ring
Allen's match with George Rooke, for $1,500 a side to be fought June 17, 1875, was declared off after the two sides failed to agree on a final stakeholder
Allen went to the fight ground on June 17, stepped into the ring alone and claimed the stakes when Rooke did not appear
Rooke challenged Allen to fight him without stakes, offering to bet $1,000 that he would win

notes: Rooke's account of the broken match is one-sided. The missing 'Another Richmond in the Field' section may also concern Allen; it needs a human to check the original page.
